vibe: Objective, rigid, functional, cinematic, high-end post-production.

headings.usage_rules: Use tracking-tight for all headings. Never use Inter. Do not center by default.

mono.usage: Use for timestamps, data metrics, and technical labels.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous spacing: p-8, p-12 for sections. For dashboard, use tight gaps (gap-4, gap-6).
layout_and_spacing.landing_page_grid: MODE A: The 'Tetris' Grid. Asymmetrical layouts, overlapping elements.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: MODE B: The 'Control Room' Grid. Strict hierarchy, dense spacing, grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Every pixel utilized.
layout_and_spacing.container_padding: Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8).

surface_strategies.navigation: Glassmorphism (The 'Crystal' Variant): backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 with 1px border-white/10.
surface_strategies.cards: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look): border-collapse style, flat bg-zinc-950, border-zinc-800. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and subtle shadow.
surface_strategies.modals_overlays: Glassmorphism with heavy blur and sharp 1px border.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Always explicitly set text color on hover (e.g., hover:bg-zinc-900 hover:text-white).
motion_and_interaction.transitions: Use specific properties, e.g., transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease.
motion_and_interaction.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for an 'Editorial Ribbon' or 'Kinetic Texture' in the landing page.

components.buttons: Flat solid surfaces with sharp 1px borders. Primary CTA uses bg-rose-600 text-white hover:bg-rose-500. Secondary uses bg-transparent border-zinc-800 text-white hover:bg-zinc-900.
components.inputs: Shadcn UI heavily customized. bg-zinc-950 border-zinc-800 text-white focus:border-rose-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-rose-500.
components.tables: Shadcn UI tables for the QA results dashboard. Use JetBrains Mono for timestamps.
components.charts: Shadcn charts/Recharts for showing QA stats over time.

media_and_icons.icon_style: Duotone or bold weights to match the high-contrast tech vibe.

images.description: Abstract curved flame/glow pattern on a dark background. Use with a heavy bg-black/50 overlay.
Video editing monitor in a dark room. Good for feature blocks.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Tint greys slightly (cool or warm, avoid pure #808080).
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on all interactive elements.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid="analyze-video-btn").

page_specific_instructions.landing_page: High visual impact. Hero section with abstract background (opacity controlled). Large typography. Link input front and center. Display a marquee of supported formats/features.
page_specific_instructions.dashboard: Cardless or sharp rectangular cards. Video player/preview on the left or top, scrolling list of timestamped grammar/spelling issues on the right. Status indicators for 'Auto-posting to Frame.io'. Use monospace for timestamps.
